construction: Every fixture, identifier, literal, row, and statement was independently authored from the aggregate observation specification; public SQLScript syntax was checked separately without consulting restricted sources.
source_exclusions: No original archive was opened or copied.
No restricted source tree was opened or copied.
No member path, filename, source identifier, comment, domain vocabulary, literal payload, algorithm, or statement sequence was retained.
No external reference was used to reconstruct restricted identifiers, payloads, algorithms, or statement sequences.
covered_categories: scalar and table parameters with opaque local types
select, where, distinct, inner join, left outer join, subquery, exists, in, between
grouping, having, ordering, limit and offset
case-free conditional branches, casts, aggregates, windows, ranking, text and regular-expression calls
date/current-value expressions, declarations, local assignment, host references, cursor declaration, block control
session context and null-bearing synthetic data
approximate-match and score-shaped calls as parse-only placeholders
a synthetic fixed INTEGER ARRAY expanded through the public UNNEST WITH ORDINALITY syntax
set difference, null substitution, mapping/default-shaped calls, and null predicates
optimizer-hint syntax, execution identity tokens, and optional/returning declaration shapes

omitted_categories.reason: The clean-room grammar fixture is intentionally limited to the observed inner and left forms; no unobserved join shape is invented.
Durable mutation semantics require an isolated runtime transaction and are not represented in a parse-only corpus.
Only cursor declaration is representable by the public grammar; no execution behavior is guessed.

omitted_categories.category: dynamic SQL, temporary-table DDL, transaction control, and exception handlers
omitted_categories.reason: Explicitly unobserved or unsupported in the sanitized specification; omitted.

omitted_categories.category: explicit null helper functions and IS NULL predicates
omitted_categories.reason: Covered by the later additive observation as syntax-only placeholders; no runtime result is asserted here.

omitted_categories.category: runtime filtering and dynamically executed SQL
omitted_categories.reason: No safe public grammar or runtime harness exists for dynamic text execution; omitted rather than inventing statement fragments.

omitted_categories.category: controlled SQL errors and native error codes
omitted_categories.reason: Explicit error statements and source-specific codes are not represented by the public grammar; omitted rather than guessing error text.
The public grammar models conditional branches but no loop or continuation statement; omitted rather than simulating control flow.

Only a fixed INTEGER ARRAY constructor, duplicate and NULL elements, UNNEST, and one-based ordinality are measured; empty arrays, other element types, mutation, concatenation, multiple arrays and ARRAY_AGG remain outside this slice.
